purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Turbo Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 120 DPI (4-page official IEBC Form 34B PDF; page 3 of 4 ends the polling-station table with an unlabelled bold TOTAL row, immediately followed on the same page by the form's own Aggregate Results and Voter Turnout summary boxes). All three sets of figures (polling-station TOTAL row, Aggregate Results table, and Voter Turnout box) agree exactly with each other.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image, then independently cross-confirmed against the form's own printed Aggregate Results table (candidate valid-vote totals in both figures and words) and Voter Turnout summary box (registered voters, turned out, percentage) on the same page. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
